en: Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story buildings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the wet street and sidewalks. At the top center, printed caption text identifies the location as Döbeln – Johannisstrasse. On the left building a large wall sign reads "Vogler A. G." and various smaller shop signs are visible further down the street.
